title: [agent-md 03/07] Serve and save project agent guidance by sections with optimistic concurrency
body:
**Blocked by:** #1546
**Model tier:** high

## Context

Model tier rationale: This adds a new owner-authorized write route with optimistic concurrency under serializable isolation, a delete path that also changes heartbeats and findings, and a tenant-isolation test, so several contracts must be right together.

After #1449 every project that had instructions has a row in `project_agent_guidance` (columns `project_item_id`, `owner_user_id`, `markdown`, `updated_at`), the single source of truth the agent prompt and the daily "Detect agent guidance drift" tick read. Nothing exposes it over HTTP yet. `createProjectAgentGuidanceService` (`backend/packages/application/src/projectAgentGuidance/service.ts`) has the owner rule (a non-owner gets 403 `owner_violation`), the 32 KiB limit (`MAX_PROJECT_AGENT_GUIDANCE_MARKDOWN_BYTES`) and the drift-heartbeat call, but `packages/data` cannot import `packages/application`, and a module custom route handler must live in a module that `packages/data` ships. The store (`backend/packages/data/src/projectAgentGuidanceStore.ts`) has `load`, `upsert` (`ON CONFLICT` with no version check) and `transfer`, and no delete.

This issue adds the HTTP API the web AGENT page (#1611) uses and the drift endpoints build on (#1629, #1630, and the project setup invalidation #1866):

- `GET /api/projects/:id/agent-guidance` returns `{ sections: { purpose, allowed, notAllowed, generalInstructions }, updatedAt, ownerUserId }`. Each section is Markdown; an empty string is an empty section. A project without guidance returns 200 with four empty sections, `updatedAt: null`, `ownerUserId: null`.
- `PUT /api/projects/:id/agent-guidance` with `{ sections, expectedUpdatedAt }` returns 200 `{ sections, updatedAt }`.

Decisions:

- Both routes are `customRoutes` of the systemDatabases module manifest (`backend/packages/data/src/seed/systemDatabasesModuleManifest.ts`; module ownership per `docs/adr/2026-09-10-single-writer-ownership-model.md`), declared per `docs/adr/2026-09-11-module-manifest-custom-routes.md`: GET as `single-consumer-read` (the shape exists for one consumer, the AGENT page), PUT as `transactional-semantics` (guidance row, heartbeat and findings change in one transaction). The handlers live in `packages/data`, built on the shared ports and stores; the rules of the existing service are reimplemented there for sections, and the existing service stays for ownership transfer.
- The server composes the canonical Markdown with `composeProjectAgentGuidanceMarkdown` (from #1449) and stores it; GET parses it back. Parsing splits on the four reserved heading lines (`## Purpose`, `## Allowed`, `## Not allowed`, `## General instructions`, matched as whole lines). Text before the first reserved heading (a row not written by this API) is returned at the start of `generalInstructions`, so nothing is lost; the next PUT canonicalizes it.
- A PUT section containing a whole line equal to a reserved heading is rejected with 400 `validation_failed`, `details: { field: "sections.<key>", reason: "reserved_heading" }` (fenced code blocks are not special-cased, to keep parse and compose exact inverses).
- `expectedUpdatedAt` is the ISO string last returned (`null` when no row exists). The comparison is done in application code after `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` on the row, comparing the ISO strings produced by `mapRow` (the column has microsecond precision, the ISO string milliseconds, so a SQL equality on the raw value would never match). A mismatch, or a PostgreSQL serialization failure `40001`, answers 409 `version_conflict` with the route returning its own body `{ error: { code: "version_conflict", details: { current: { sections, updatedAt, ownerUserId } } } }` (a custom route may return its own body; the generic error mapper would drop the non-flat details). No row is changed on conflict.
- Unknown project id: 404 `not_found`. Non-UUID `:id`: 400 `validation_failed`.
- Payload above 32 KiB after composition: 400 `validation_failed`, `details: { field: "sections", reason: "too_long" }`.
- All four sections empty: the row is deleted (new `delete` on the store), the project's drift heartbeat is disabled, active drift findings of the project are resolved in the same transaction without writing notifications (there is no guidance left to be in conflict), and the response is 200 with four empty sections and `updatedAt: null`. With no existing row, an all-empty PUT (with `expectedUpdatedAt: null`) is a no-op 200.
- Only the row's owner may write. The first write to a project without a row makes the caller the owner if the caller is the tenant's user (`guidanceReferenceStore.requireUser`), else 403 `owner_violation`.

Shared-file ordering: this issue also waits for #1546 because both edit the same registry, manifest, cutover, route matrix or hook files listed in Touches.

## Task

Load `state-writes`, `error-handling`, `io-hardening` and `testing`.

1. In `backend/packages/shared/src/projectAgentGuidance.ts` add `parseProjectAgentGuidanceMarkdown(markdown)` and `findReservedHeading(sections)`; extend `ProjectAgentGuidanceStore` with `delete(tx, projectItemId)` and `GuidanceHeartbeatStore` with `disableDriftHeartbeat(tx, projectItemId)`.
2. Implement `delete` in `backend/packages/data/src/projectAgentGuidanceStore.ts` and `disableDriftHeartbeat` (sets `enabled = false`; `upsertDriftHeartbeat` re-enables it) in `backend/packages/data/src/guidanceDrift/guidanceDriftHeartbeatStore.ts`.
3. Create `backend/packages/data/src/projectAgentGuidance/projectAgentGuidanceSections.ts` exporting two functions that take a transaction, so later routes can reuse them: `loadGuidanceSections(tx, projectItemId)` and `saveGuidanceSections(tx, { actorUserId, projectItemId, sections, expectedUpdatedAt })`, implementing all rules in Context (serializable isolation is set by the caller's transaction).
4. Create `backend/packages/data/src/projectAgentGuidance/projectAgentGuidanceRouteHandlers.ts` exporting `createProjectAgentGuidanceReadRouteHandler(pool)` and `createProjectAgentGuidanceSaveRouteHandler(pool)` (the save handler runs `saveGuidanceSections` in a serializable transaction and maps `40001` to the 409 body; the user comes from the request context's identity).
5. Declare both routes in the systemDatabases manifest (`customRoutes` names `readProjectAgentGuidance`, `saveProjectAgentGuidance`, with the justifications above) and export the handlers from the manifest module.
6. Add both entries to `backend/services/semprec-api/src/routeMatrix.ts` (authenticated, tenant-scoped), map them in `ROUTE_HANDLER_FILES` in `backend/services/semprec-api/src/__tests__/chokePointWriteBoundary.unit.test.ts`, and add their cases to `backend/services/semprec-api/src/__tests__/tenantIsolationRoutes.test.ts`.
7. Tests: round trip of compose and parse, the reserved heading, the conflict (a stale `expectedUpdatedAt` and a forced serialization failure), the owner rule, the size limit, the delete path (row, heartbeat, findings), and a route test showing that after a PUT the next `createProjectAgentGuidanceSystemPromptOverride` result contains the new text and a `core.agentGuidanceDrift` heartbeat exists.

## Touches

- backend/packages/shared/src/projectAgentGuidance.ts (parse, reserved heading check, store and heartbeat port methods)
- backend/packages/data/src/projectAgentGuidanceStore.ts (`delete`)
- backend/packages/data/src/guidanceDrift/guidanceDriftHeartbeatStore.ts (`disableDriftHeartbeat`)
- backend/packages/data/src/projectAgentGuidance/projectAgentGuidanceSections.ts (new)
- backend/packages/data/src/projectAgentGuidance/projectAgentGuidanceRouteHandlers.ts (new)
- backend/packages/data/src/seed/systemDatabasesModuleManifest.ts (`customRoutes` and handler exports)
- backend/packages/data/src/index.ts (export lines)
- backend/packages/data/src/__tests__/publicSurface.test.ts (names in `EXPECTED_RUNTIME_EXPORTS`)
- backend/packages/application/src/projectAgentGuidance/__tests__/service.unit.test.ts (fakes updated for the extended ports, only if they fail to type-check)
- backend/services/semprec-api/src/routeMatrix.ts (two entries)
- backend/services/semprec-api/src/__tests__/chokePointWriteBoundary.unit.test.ts (two `ROUTE_HANDLER_FILES` entries)
- backend/services/semprec-api/src/__tests__/tenantIsolationRoutes.test.ts (two cases)
- backend/packages/data/src/projectAgentGuidance/__tests__/ (new tests)

## Scope

### In scope

- The two routes, the section codec, optimistic concurrency, the delete path and the reusable in-transaction save and load functions.

### Out of scope

- Moving the existing text into the table: #1449.
- The web page and removing `projects.agents`: #1611.
- Drift findings over HTTP and resolving them by amending a section: #1630, #1685.
- Realtime invalidation of an open AGENT page when guidance changes: #1866.
- Ownership transfer over HTTP (the service's `transferProjectAgentGuidance` keeps no HTTP caller).

## Acceptance criteria

- When a project has no guidance, then GET answers 200 with four empty sections and `updatedAt: null`.
- When the owner PUTs sections with the current `expectedUpdatedAt`, then the response holds the same sections and a new `updatedAt`, the project's next agent prompt contains "## Project-specific guidance" with the new text, and an enabled `core.agentGuidanceDrift` heartbeat exists.
- When a second client PUTs with the old `expectedUpdatedAt`, then it gets 409 `version_conflict` with the current content in `details.current`, and nothing is overwritten. A concurrent pair of writes ends with one success and one 409.
- When a section contains a line `## Allowed`, then the response is 400 `validation_failed` with `field` `sections.<key>` and `reason` `reserved_heading`.
- When the composed document is above 32 KiB, then 400 `too_long`; when the caller is not the owner, then 403 `owner_violation`.
- When all four sections are empty, then the row is gone, the heartbeat is disabled and the project's active drift findings are resolved without notifications.
- The isolation test shows tenant B cannot read or write tenant A's guidance (404 for A's project id).
